meta.title: Cry
meta.description: Listen! Hear me cry my misfortune! Behold! Watch as I trample it along with you.

units.rawText: Slightly earlier today at Puzzle's workshop.
units.displayText: Slightly earlier today at Puzzle's workshop.

spans.text: Slightly earlier today at Puzzle's workshop.

units.rawText: You actually... ambushed me...
units.displayText: You actually... ambushed me...

spans.text: You actually... ambushed me...

units.rawText: It was legitimate self-defense.
units.displayText: It was legitimate self-defense.

spans.text: It was legitimate self-defense.

units.rawText: Persicaria, knock her out and take her away!
units.displayText: Persicaria, knock her out and take her away!

spans.text: Persicaria, knock her out and take her away!

units.rawText: Huh? Yes!
units.displayText: Huh? Yes!

spans.text: Huh? Yes!

units.rawText: Aaaaahhhh wait, you savages! I'm against violence!
units.displayText: Aaaaahhhh wait, you savages! I'm against violence!

spans.text: Aaaaahhhh wait, you savages! I'm against violence!

units.rawText: Listen to me, just hear me out!
units.displayText: Listen to me, just hear me out!

spans.text: Listen to me, just hear me out!

units.rawText: You're not going to summon statues to attack us, are you?
units.displayText: You're not going to summon statues to attack us, are you?

spans.text: You're not going to summon statues to attack us, are you?

units.rawText: No, not any more! Look at the state of me now!
units.displayText: No, not any more! Look at the state of me now!

spans.text: No, not any more! Look at the state of me now!

units.rawText: I yield, I yield. Isn't that enough?
units.displayText: I yield, I yield. Isn't that enough?

spans.text: I yield, I yield. Isn't that enough?

units.rawText: I did install neural clouds in those statues, but they were definitely harmless. They had no berserk functions in them!
units.displayText: I did install neural clouds in those statues, but they were definitely harmless. They had no berserk functions in them!

spans.text: I did install neural clouds in those statues, but they were definitely harmless. They had no berserk functions in them!

units.rawText: Then why did you put neural clouds in them?
units.displayText: Then why did you put neural clouds in them?

spans.text: Then why did you put neural clouds in them?

units.rawText: For the pursuit of art, of course!
units.displayText: For the pursuit of art, of course!

spans.text: For the pursuit of art, of course!

units.rawText: The pursuit of art? And your pursuit involves causing all this chaos?
units.displayText: The pursuit of art? And your pursuit involves causing all this chaos?

spans.text: The pursuit of art? And your pursuit involves causing all this chaos?

units.rawText: Well... Can what an artist creates be called chaos?
units.displayText: Well... Can what an artist creates be called chaos?

spans.text: Well... Can what an artist creates be called chaos?

units.rawText: This is the pursuit of art in its utmost, to summon up inspiration! Don't these inspire something in you, like what explorers saw when they beheld the statues within a sunken, spiral city?
units.displayText: This is the pursuit of art in its utmost, to summon up inspiration! Don't these inspire something in you, like what explorers saw when they beheld the statues within a sunken, spiral city?

spans.text: This is the pursuit of art in its utmost, to summon up inspiration! Don't these inspire something in you, like what explorers saw when they beheld the statues within a sunken, spiral city?

units.rawText: I'll let you say one more thing. Go ahead.
units.displayText: I'll let you say one more thing. Go ahead.

spans.text: I'll let you say one more thing. Go ahead.

units.rawText: ...I really didn't do it! Do you think you could catch me now if it really was me?
units.displayText: ...I really didn't do it! Do you think you could catch me now if it really was me?

spans.text: ...I really didn't do it! Do you think you could catch me now if it really was me?
Believe Puzzle.
Don't believe Puzzle.

units.rawText: Alright, you don't look like you're lying.
units.displayText: Alright, you don't look like you're lying.

spans.text: Alright, you don't look like you're lying.

units.rawText: Hmph, good thing you're reasonable. Rejoice, because if you had hit me, you wouldn't have been able to deal with the consequences!
units.displayText: Hmph, good thing you're reasonable. Rejoice, because if you had hit me, you wouldn't have been able to deal with the consequences!

spans.text: Hmph, good thing you're reasonable. Rejoice, because if you had hit me, you wouldn't have been able to deal with the consequences!

units.rawText: Actually, that makes me curious, exactly what kind of consequences would those be?
units.displayText: Actually, that makes me curious, exactly what kind of consequences would those be?

spans.text: Actually, that makes me curious, exactly what kind of consequences would those be?

units.rawText: I'd have carved your faces onto shit golems.
units.displayText: I'd have carved your faces onto shit golems.

spans.text: I'd have carved your faces onto shit golems.

units.rawText: If that's all you can say, then do it, Persicaria.
units.displayText: If that's all you can say, then do it, Persicaria.

spans.text: If that's all you can say, then do it, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Aaaaahhhhh I won't let you go even after I'm reset!
units.displayText: Aaaaahhhhh I won't let you go even after I'm reset!

spans.text: Aaaaahhhhh I won't let you go even after I'm reset!

units.rawText: Upon seeing that her arguments are ineffective, Puzzle puts up her hands to protect her face and wails in despair.
units.displayText: Upon seeing that her arguments are ineffective, Puzzle puts up her hands to protect her face and wails in despair.

spans.text: Upon seeing that her arguments are ineffective, Puzzle puts up her hands to protect her face and wails in despair.

units.rawText: Professor, are we really going to do this?
units.displayText: Professor, are we really going to do this?

spans.text: Professor, are we really going to do this?

units.rawText: ...Nah.
units.displayText: ...Nah.

spans.text: ...Nah.

units.rawText: YOU WERE BLUFFING ME?!
units.displayText: YOU WERE BLUFFING ME?!

spans.text: YOU WERE BLUFFING ME?!

units.rawText: You don't LOOK like the culprit, but we don't have any evidence to prove that at the moment.
units.displayText: You don't LOOK like the culprit, but we don't have any evidence to prove that at the moment.

spans.text: You don't LOOK like the culprit, but we don't have any evidence to prove that at the moment.

units.rawText: If you want to prove your innocence, then you'll have to help us find the real mastermind.
units.displayText: If you want to prove your innocence, then you'll have to help us find the real mastermind.

spans.text: If you want to prove your innocence, then you'll have to help us find the real mastermind.

units.rawText: Even if you say that, I'm just a sculptor. What can I do?
units.displayText: Even if you say that, I'm just a sculptor. What can I do?

spans.text: Even if you say that, I'm just a sculptor. What can I do?

units.rawText: How did you install neural clouds into those statues? It doesn't look like something Dolls are authorized to do.
units.displayText: How did you install neural clouds into those statues? It doesn't look like something Dolls are authorized to do.

spans.text: How did you install neural clouds into those statues? It doesn't look like something Dolls are authorized to do.

units.rawText: Hehe~ Well, if you want to make something really good, then you need to look at the world from a different point of view, right?
units.displayText: Hehe~ Well, if you want to make something really good, then you need to look at the world from a different point of view, right?

spans.text: Hehe~ Well, if you want to make something really good, then you need to look at the world from a different point of view, right?

units.rawText: Transferring neural clouds is a piece of cake for me! With the right kind of carrier, even becoming a cat would be easy.
units.displayText: Transferring neural clouds is a piece of cake for me! With the right kind of carrier, even becoming a cat would be easy.

spans.text: Transferring neural clouds is a piece of cake for me! With the right kind of carrier, even becoming a cat would be easy.

units.rawText: In the past, I often became a cat and went around observing agents to gather material for my creations. Hehe, that's an artist's trade secret...
units.displayText: In the past, I often became a cat and went around observing agents to gather material for my creations. Hehe, that's an artist's trade secret...

spans.text: In the past, I often became a cat and went around observing agents to gather material for my creations. Hehe, that's an artist's trade secret...

units.rawText: Good.
units.displayText: Good.

spans.text: Good.

units.rawText: Wait, what are you going to do?
units.displayText: Wait, what are you going to do?

spans.text: Wait, what are you going to do?

units.rawText: Just do as I say. As long as you stay within view of me, it will prove your innocence.
units.displayText: Just do as I say. As long as you stay within view of me, it will prove your innocence.

spans.text: Just do as I say. As long as you stay within view of me, it will prove your innocence.

units.rawText: Also, once the REAL mastermind finds that we've tied you up, they'll definitely make a move...
units.displayText: Also, once the REAL mastermind finds that we've tied you up, they'll definitely make a move...

spans.text: Also, once the REAL mastermind finds that we've tied you up, they'll definitely make a move...

units.rawText: Back to the present, in Puzzle's workshop.
units.displayText: Back to the present, in Puzzle's workshop.

spans.text: Back to the present, in Puzzle's workshop.

units.rawText: Hmph, I see now. You left your empty shell here, but moved your neural cloud to the cat.
units.displayText: Hmph, I see now. You left your empty shell here, but moved your neural cloud to the cat.

spans.text: Hmph, I see now. You left your empty shell here, but moved your neural cloud to the cat.

units.rawText: Like I said, just about everything in the Burbank Sector has been through my hands, so how could there be such a fancy critter like that here?
units.displayText: Like I said, just about everything in the Burbank Sector has been through my hands, so how could there be such a fancy critter like that here?

spans.text: Like I said, just about everything in the Burbank Sector has been through my hands, so how could there be such a fancy critter like that here?

units.rawText: This... This is the power of an artist...
units.displayText: This... This is the power of an artist...

spans.text: This... This is the power of an artist...

units.rawText: Puzzle leans up against Sol's leg, a small patch of deep purple on her colorful back.
units.displayText: Puzzle leans up against Sol's leg, a small patch of deep purple on her colorful back.

spans.text: Puzzle leans up against Sol's leg, a small patch of deep purple on her colorful back.

units.rawText: Are you alright, Puzzle...
units.displayText: Are you alright, Puzzle...

spans.text: Are you alright, Puzzle...

units.rawText: It's just a scratch, whose fault do you think it is that I had to save you from a sneak attack, anyway?
units.displayText: It's just a scratch, whose fault do you think it is that I had to save you from a sneak attack, anyway?

spans.text: It's just a scratch, whose fault do you think it is that I had to save you from a sneak attack, anyway?

units.rawText: Sorry... Go hide!
units.displayText: Sorry... Go hide!

spans.text: Sorry... Go hide!

units.rawText: Ladies, don't you think you're taking me a LITTLE too lightly by discussing your battle plans in front of me?
units.displayText: Ladies, don't you think you're taking me a LITTLE too lightly by discussing your battle plans in front of me?

spans.text: Ladies, don't you think you're taking me a LITTLE too lightly by discussing your battle plans in front of me?

units.rawText: Ranko waves her tail and purplish-black vapors slowly fill the workshop.
units.displayText: Ranko waves her tail and purplish-black vapors slowly fill the workshop.

spans.text: Ranko waves her tail and purplish-black vapors slowly fill the workshop.

units.rawText: All the statues in this workshop are my weapons. I'll eliminate all of you.
units.displayText: All the statues in this workshop are my weapons. I'll eliminate all of you.

spans.text: All the statues in this workshop are my weapons. I'll eliminate all of you.

units.rawText: Why did you do this, Miss Ranko?
units.displayText: Why did you do this, Miss Ranko?

spans.text: Why did you do this, Miss Ranko?

units.rawText: Trying to stall for time so help can arrive? Don't try to be smart.
units.displayText: Trying to stall for time so help can arrive? Don't try to be smart.

spans.text: Trying to stall for time so help can arrive? Don't try to be smart.

units.rawText: I'm the strong one now. The weak don't deserve to negotiate terms with me. Now die.
units.displayText: I'm the strong one now. The weak don't deserve to negotiate terms with me. Now die.

spans.text: I'm the strong one now. The weak don't deserve to negotiate terms with me. Now die.

units.rawText: Dammit, looks like there's no choice but to fight!
units.displayText: Dammit, looks like there's no choice but to fight!

spans.text: Dammit, looks like there's no choice but to fight!

units.rawText: Suits me just fine.
units.displayText: Suits me just fine.

spans.text: Suits me just fine.

units.rawText: The entire gallery starts to shudder and the statues all around them begin to wake up, an ominous light in their eyes.
units.displayText: The entire gallery starts to shudder and the statues all around them begin to wake up, an ominous light in their eyes.

spans.text: The entire gallery starts to shudder and the statues all around them begin to wake up, an ominous light in their eyes.

units.rawText: Faced with the horde of statues, Persicaria and Sol have no choice but to avoid them, but there's less and less room to maneuver in.
units.displayText: Faced with the horde of statues, Persicaria and Sol have no choice but to avoid them, but there's less and less room to maneuver in.

spans.text: Faced with the horde of statues, Persicaria and Sol have no choice but to avoid them, but there's less and less room to maneuver in.

units.rawText: Yes, that's right, just die like that.
units.displayText: Yes, that's right, just die like that.

spans.text: Yes, that's right, just die like that.

units.rawText: Once I deal with you, the Professor and company will be nothing more than pathetic little animals in my trap...
units.displayText: Once I deal with you, the Professor and company will be nothing more than pathetic little animals in my trap...

spans.text: Once I deal with you, the Professor and company will be nothing more than pathetic little animals in my trap...

units.rawText: And you. Did you think I couldn't see you, Puzzle?
units.displayText: And you. Did you think I couldn't see you, Puzzle?

spans.text: And you. Did you think I couldn't see you, Puzzle?

units.rawText: Meow... You sure are sharp. And here I am, just a tiny little thing.
units.displayText: Meow... You sure are sharp. And here I am, just a tiny little thing.

spans.text: Meow... You sure are sharp. And here I am, just a tiny little thing.

units.rawText: I can make it quick for you.
units.displayText: I can make it quick for you.

spans.text: I can make it quick for you.

units.rawText: Wait wait wait, I know you won't let me off, but there's something I have to say ~meow!
units.displayText: Wait wait wait, I know you won't let me off, but there's something I have to say ~meow!

spans.text: Wait wait wait, I know you won't let me off, but there's something I have to say ~meow!

units.rawText: Are you trying to buy time?
units.displayText: Are you trying to buy time?

spans.text: Are you trying to buy time?

units.rawText: Not really. I really want to live, and I don't care if the others live or die.
units.displayText: Not really. I really want to live, and I don't care if the others live or die.

spans.text: Not really. I really want to live, and I don't care if the others live or die.

units.rawText: Can't you make a deal and let me off, just me?
units.displayText: Can't you make a deal and let me off, just me?

spans.text: Can't you make a deal and let me off, just me?

units.rawText: Puzzle, you bi- ...No, you molly!
units.displayText: Puzzle, you bi- ...No, you molly!

spans.text: Puzzle, you bi- ...No, you molly!

units.rawText: Is this how you pay us back for risking our lives to save you, by selling us out?!
units.displayText: Is this how you pay us back for risking our lives to save you, by selling us out?!

spans.text: Is this how you pay us back for risking our lives to save you, by selling us out?!

units.rawText: Oh come off it, you didn't even know I was working with the Professor. You were here to catch me!
units.displayText: Oh come off it, you didn't even know I was working with the Professor. You were here to catch me!

spans.text: Oh come off it, you didn't even know I was working with the Professor. You were here to catch me!

units.rawText: Even a little kitty like me won't take it lying down when you mobilize a huge gang of people to bully me!
units.displayText: Even a little kitty like me won't take it lying down when you mobilize a huge gang of people to bully me!

spans.text: Even a little kitty like me won't take it lying down when you mobilize a huge gang of people to bully me!

units.rawText: Shut up, all of you.
units.displayText: Shut up, all of you.

spans.text: Shut up, all of you.

units.rawText: Tell me, what are you offering in exchange?
units.displayText: Tell me, what are you offering in exchange?

spans.text: Tell me, what are you offering in exchange?

units.rawText: Haven't you ever felt bothered by how I could make basic neural clouds in the Burbank Sector and then graft them?
units.displayText: Haven't you ever felt bothered by how I could make basic neural clouds in the Burbank Sector and then graft them?

spans.text: Haven't you ever felt bothered by how I could make basic neural clouds in the Burbank Sector and then graft them?

units.rawText: Is this valuable to me?
units.displayText: Is this valuable to me?

spans.text: Is this valuable to me?

units.rawText: It's the perfect way to disguise things!
units.displayText: It's the perfect way to disguise things!

spans.text: It's the perfect way to disguise things!

units.rawText: Think about it, you've been Entropized now, so if you could disguise your Entropized parts as a freshly-created normal neural cloud, don't you think you could trick the Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: Think about it, you've been Entropized now, so if you could disguise your Entropized parts as a freshly-created normal neural cloud, don't you think you could trick the Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Think about it, you've been Entropized now, so if you could disguise your Entropized parts as a freshly-created normal neural cloud, don't you think you could trick the Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Tell me how.
units.displayText: Tell me how.

spans.text: Tell me how.

units.rawText: Go check my body... No, not me, Purrzle, the real Puzzle's body!
units.displayText: Go check my body... No, not me, Purrzle, the real Puzzle's body!

spans.text: Go check my body... No, not me, Purrzle, the real Puzzle's body!

units.rawText: The moment Ranko turns around, Purrzle seizes the opportunity to dart through the statues protecting Ranko and bite her tail!
units.displayText: The moment Ranko turns around, Purrzle seizes the opportunity to dart through the statues protecting Ranko and bite her tail!

spans.text: The moment Ranko turns around, Purrzle seizes the opportunity to dart through the statues protecting Ranko and bite her tail!

units.rawText: Tch...
units.displayText: Tch...

spans.text: Tch...

units.rawText: Ranko flicks her tail and slams Purrzle to the ground.
units.displayText: Ranko flicks her tail and slams Purrzle to the ground.

spans.text: Ranko flicks her tail and slams Purrzle to the ground.

units.rawText: Peh, I got a mouthful of stinky fox fur...
units.displayText: Peh, I got a mouthful of stinky fox fur...

spans.text: Peh, I got a mouthful of stinky fox fur...

units.rawText: Got you now, you damn cat.
units.displayText: Got you now, you damn cat.

spans.text: Got you now, you damn cat.

units.rawText: Ranko plants a foot on Purrzle and looms down over her.
units.displayText: Ranko plants a foot on Purrzle and looms down over her.

spans.text: Ranko plants a foot on Purrzle and looms down over her.

units.rawText: Myaaa-hssss!
units.displayText: Myaaa-hssss!

spans.text: Myaaa-hssss!

units.rawText: Unable to react in time, Purrzle is squished into a furry pan-cat, her legs splayed open.
units.displayText: Unable to react in time, Purrzle is squished into a furry pan-cat, her legs splayed open.

spans.text: Unable to react in time, Purrzle is squished into a furry pan-cat, her legs splayed open.

units.rawText: You really thought you could fool me so easily? I was just waiting to see what tricks you would pull.
units.displayText: You really thought you could fool me so easily? I was just waiting to see what tricks you would pull.

spans.text: You really thought you could fool me so easily? I was just waiting to see what tricks you would pull.

units.rawText: Who would have thought your last performance would be so clumsy? You fail as an artist, but you're just right to be a clown.
units.displayText: Who would have thought your last performance would be so clumsy? You fail as an artist, but you're just right to be a clown.

spans.text: Who would have thought your last performance would be so clumsy? You fail as an artist, but you're just right to be a clown.

units.rawText: <color=orange>"Watchers of tragedy..."</color>
units.displayText: "Watchers of tragedy..."

spans.text: "Watchers of tragedy..."

units.rawText: Just die already.
units.displayText: Just die already.

spans.text: Just die already.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=orange>"Arise!"</color></size>
units.displayText: "Arise!"

spans.text: "Arise!"

units.rawText: Crack– crack, crack–
units.displayText: Crack– crack, crack–

spans.text: Crack– crack, crack–

units.rawText: Just as Ranko is about to finish Purrzle off, the statues suddenly begin to shudder.
units.displayText: Just as Ranko is about to finish Purrzle off, the statues suddenly begin to shudder.

spans.text: Just as Ranko is about to finish Purrzle off, the statues suddenly begin to shudder.

units.rawText: Right after that, the sound of explosions fills the air, one after another.
units.displayText: Right after that, the sound of explosions fills the air, one after another.

spans.text: Right after that, the sound of explosions fills the air, one after another.

units.rawText: You?!
units.displayText: You?!

spans.text: You?!

units.rawText: Ranko is stunned. It is only then that she realizes that there's a small controller device in between the tufts of Purrzle's fur.
units.displayText: Ranko is stunned. It is only then that she realizes that there's a small controller device in between the tufts of Purrzle's fur.

spans.text: Ranko is stunned. It is only then that she realizes that there's a small controller device in between the tufts of Purrzle's fur.

units.rawText: As Sol and Persicaria make a mess of things with their resistance, the cable stealthily extends toward the control terminal.
units.displayText: As Sol and Persicaria make a mess of things with their resistance, the cable stealthily extends toward the control terminal.

spans.text: As Sol and Persicaria make a mess of things with their resistance, the cable stealthily extends toward the control terminal.

units.rawText: So that string of nonsense was actually a code... You were feinting?!
units.displayText: So that string of nonsense was actually a code... You were feinting?!

spans.text: So that string of nonsense was actually a code... You were feinting?!

units.rawText: This is your own work...
units.displayText: This is your own work...

spans.text: This is your own work...

units.rawText: Oh no, my strength...
units.displayText: Oh no, my strength...

spans.text: Oh no, my strength...

units.rawText: Haha... I... am a very picky artist...
units.displayText: Haha... I... am a very picky artist...

spans.text: Haha... I... am a very picky artist...

units.rawText: There's no way... I'd acknowledge such ugly statues as my work... Which means all I can do is destroy them...!
units.displayText: There's no way... I'd acknowledge such ugly statues as my work... Which means all I can do is destroy them...!

spans.text: There's no way... I'd acknowledge such ugly statues as my work... Which means all I can do is destroy them...!

units.rawText: And it doesn't bother me at all... It's your own fault... That your aesthetic sense sucks... Hahaha...
units.displayText: And it doesn't bother me at all... It's your own fault... That your aesthetic sense sucks... Hahaha...

spans.text: And it doesn't bother me at all... It's your own fault... That your aesthetic sense sucks... Hahaha...

units.rawText: That's enough, now die–
units.displayText: That's enough, now die–

spans.text: That's enough, now die–

units.rawText: Bam!
units.displayText: Bam!

spans.text: Bam!

units.rawText: The door to the workshop suddenly flies open.
units.displayText: The door to the workshop suddenly flies open.

spans.text: The door to the workshop suddenly flies open.

units.rawText: Sol, Persicaria, we're here!
units.displayText: Sol, Persicaria, we're here!

spans.text: Sol, Persicaria, we're here!

units.rawText: It's Nascita! And the Professor!
units.displayText: It's Nascita! And the Professor!

spans.text: It's Nascita! And the Professor!

units.rawText: Hehe... Professor... Mission... Accomplished...
units.displayText: Hehe... Professor... Mission... Accomplished...

spans.text: Hehe... Professor... Mission... Accomplished...

units.rawText: Make sure... you keep your word... and cover... the workshop damages...
units.displayText: Make sure... you keep your word... and cover... the workshop damages...

spans.text: Make sure... you keep your word... and cover... the workshop damages...

units.rawText: I've only lost a few statues. I won't admit defeat!
units.displayText: I've only lost a few statues. I won't admit defeat!

spans.text: I've only lost a few statues. I won't admit defeat!

units.rawText: Ranko sends Purrzle flying with a kick and suddenly springs up, the purple traces of Entropization spreading over her hands.
units.displayText: Ranko sends Purrzle flying with a kick and suddenly springs up, the purple traces of Entropization spreading over her hands.

spans.text: Ranko sends Purrzle flying with a kick and suddenly springs up, the purple traces of Entropization spreading over her hands.

units.rawText: Don't try to stop me! I'll kill everyone in my way!
units.displayText: Don't try to stop me! I'll kill everyone in my way!

spans.text: Don't try to stop me! I'll kill everyone in my way!

units.rawText: Just watch... This is what I've wanted... What we Traders have always needed... Absolute power!
units.displayText: Just watch... This is what I've wanted... What we Traders have always needed... Absolute power!

spans.text: Just watch... This is what I've wanted... What we Traders have always needed... Absolute power!

units.rawText: ...Ranko?
units.displayText: ...Ranko?

spans.text: ...Ranko?

units.rawText: A familiar voice interrupts Ranko's train of thought.
units.displayText: A familiar voice interrupts Ranko's train of thought.

spans.text: A familiar voice interrupts Ranko's train of thought.

units.rawText: She turns stiffly toward the entrance. There, in that brightly-lit world, stands a familiar figure.
units.displayText: She turns stiffly toward the entrance. There, in that brightly-lit world, stands a familiar figure.

spans.text: She turns stiffly toward the entrance. There, in that brightly-lit world, stands a familiar figure.

units.rawText: Miss... Riko?
units.displayText: Miss... Riko?

spans.text: Miss... Riko?
